instruction: A candid wedding photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Outdoors next to a yellow wall, the blonde man with a mullet in a black velvet suit (R2) on the left and the dark-haired man in a navy suit (R1) on the right are slow dancing. They lean in close with eyes closed, their noses touching as they prepare to kiss, holding hands in soft daylight.
